meta.parties: Vallipuram Et Al. v. Gasperson Et Al

rules.statement: A fideicommissary gift involving a benefit to the family is valid upon acceptance by the fiduciary alone, enuring to the benefit of the fideicommissaries.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would hold that P1 involves a benefit to the family and that Rasathangam's acceptance of It is sufficient acceptance on behalf of her children."
